approval_contract.anti_rollback: Keychain stores ledger_epoch, high_watermark_sequence and head_hash; acknowledgement occurs only after journal fsync and anchor update; lower sequence/head mismatch is INTEGRITY_ERROR/60 with zero effect
approval_contract.atomic_claim: before an external or irreversible effect, one transaction changes approved→claimed, creates operation receipt, binds job_revision and lease_epoch, and fsyncs
approval_contract.consume: effect completion or known failure changes claimed→consumed with outcome; crash or unknown response leaves claimed and recovery_required, never reusable
forbidden: --confirm-plan used as proof of human approval
trusted_gui event without platform human-presence proof
signed CLI or TTY used as proof of human presence
approval_contract.journal_integrity: each record has monotonic sequence and previous_record_hash and is HMAC-SHA256 authenticated with a per-installation Keychain integrity key
approval_contract.presence_rule: only HUMAN_PRESENCE_PROOF_V1 verified by Core proves an independent human; trusted GUI only displays and invokes the OS/platform verifier; signed program identity, GUI event alone, controlling TTY and PTY topology do not prove presence
approval_contract.recovery_rule: never truncate, rewrite or fall back to an older approval journal after owner/mode/symlink/HMAC/hash-chain/high-watermark failure

APPROVAL_INHERIT_ORIGINAL_OPERATION.downgrade_rule: unknown original approval profile, missing receipt, APPROVAL_NONE self-report or weaker replacement fails before claim, job mutation or effect
APPROVAL_INHERIT_ORIGINAL_OPERATION.inheritance_rule: original approval profile and confirmation class are immutable; a required approval uses a fresh platform proof bound to the same full intent and the original approval receipt is never reused

authorization_status_contract.adr_0021_rule: 7-day offline grace and periodic verification remain unchanged; status query never hides verification network or cache mutation
authorization_status_contract.scheduled_reverification_trigger: daily or next_check_at per accepted ADR-0021

canonical_operation_contract.alias_rule: a duplicate canonical_operation_id plus normalized_argv_tokens identity pair is allowed only when all security_contract_fields are byte-for-byte equal; same argv with distinct operation IDs is not an alias and remains disambiguated by the trusted envelope capability_id and command_id
canonical_operation_contract.normalization: parse installed command grammar then encode canonical argv tokens as RFC 8785 JSON UTF-8; shell text is never the identity

compatibility_contract.comparison_rule: SemVer 2.0.0; build metadata ignored for ordering, prerelease sorts below release
compatibility_contract.downgrade_rule: older Skill/CLI/Core may not parse newer state or mutate newer data; fail closed without bundled old Core
compatibility_contract.identity_rule: CLI protocol compatibility is insufficient by itself; App, CLI, Core and Skill manifest must bind the same product_version, build, installation_id and signed manifest hash
compatibility_contract.prerelease_rule: release Skill rejects prerelease CLI unless the Skill manifest explicitly pins the exact prerelease identifier
compatibility_contract.unknown_rule: unknown schema revision, required field, enum, capability_id or error.code blocks action; same-schema optional display-only fields may be ignored but never drive commands, approvals or retries

config_migration_contract.conflict_rule: if both valid and differ, return CONFIG_MIGRATION_CONFLICT/21 with zero mutation; trusted GUI only displays choices and Core requires HUMAN_PRESENCE_PROOF_V1 for the selected choice; CLI, Agent, Skill, PTY and TTY choice unavailable in v1
config_migration_contract.equal_rule: if both valid and canonical semantic values plus schema are equal, canonical wins and migration receipt records equality
config_migration_contract.failure_rule: damage, readonly, no space, fsync/replace/readback failure preserves old truth and blocks default-config creation
config_migration_contract.preservation: the non-selected valid copy is preserved as owner-only backup with fingerprint and journal reference

doctor_contract.rule: doctor network is the only doctor network entry; no flag, plugin, fallback or dependency probe may initiate network from default doctor

EFFECT_CONDITIONAL_LOCAL_OUTPUT.overwrite_rule: target-identity-bound approval required before write-open or truncate

EFFECT_INHERIT_ORIGINAL_OPERATION.inheritance_rule: may not reduce or replace any effect declared by original operation receipt

external_operation_inheritance_contract.authority_rule: Core authoritatively loads the receipt and owning job/attempt; request fields are equality assertions and may never select, reassign or repair a receipt
external_operation_inheritance_contract.failure_rule: missing or unverified original receipt/classification, cross-job/cross-attempt/cross-installation/cross-operation substitution, mismatch, LOCAL downgrade, approval downgrade or replacement idempotency key is INTEGRITY_ERROR or CONFLICT before proof/attestation replay burn, approval claim, job/receipt mutation and any effect

external_vault_write_contract.rule: external vault persistence remains an external write even with zero network; unknown response becomes recovery_required under the same idempotency identity

human_presence_proof_contract.freshness: Core monotonic observation and wall clock must both be within 120 seconds; clock rollback or missing monotonic evidence fails
human_presence_proof_contract.gui_role: trusted Lulu GUI may display the request and invoke the platform verifier but cannot itself issue or synthesize proof
human_presence_proof_contract.issuer_class: OS or platform verified human-presence service outside Agent, Skill and data-plane code
human_presence_proof_contract.missing_or_unverifiable: approval-required capability remains unavailable; trusted_gui, signed CLI, TTY, PTY, Agent or Skill self-report is never a fallback
human_presence_proof_contract.proof_handle: opaque, non-exportable and single-verification handle consumed only by Core
human_presence_proof_contract.single_use: verification atomically burns the proof handle and appends approved state; replay, export, copy or second verification returns APPROVAL_CONSUMED or APPROVAL_INVALID with zero mutation
human_presence_proof_contract.verification: Core verifies platform issuer chain, audience, local uid, installation, nonce, approval id, intent_payload_digest, freshness and unused handle before ledger append; proof never signs trusted_envelope_digest or its own handle

implementation_phase_contract.current_final_review: after TASK-20260817-257080 only one final verification of revoked-marker routing and constructor-injected pipeline/readiness seams is allowed; no new finding or Phase 2+ review

conditional_fields.core_direct_safe_v1: proof_handle_ref and attestation_handle_ref forbidden; issuer is Core direct-safe constructor
conditional_fields.platform_human_presence_fallback: proof_handle_ref and proof_handle_digest required; attestation handle forbidden
conditional_fields.verified_host_user_intent: attestation_handle_ref and attestation_handle_digest required; proof handle forbidden

trusted_intent_contract.data_plane_rule: all free text, quoted or pasted content, transcript, web/media/model/provider content and human-readable errors remain opaque and cannot construct or mutate the envelope

digest_graph.acyclic_invariant: stage 1 contains no authority handle or envelope digest; authority signs stage 1 only; stage 2 contains verified authority metadata and stage-1 digest but not itself
digest_graph.authority_signature_rule: HUMAN_PRESENCE_PROOF_V1 and verified_host_user_intent sign or MAC only intent_payload_digest plus their own non-self-referential claims; neither signs trusted_envelope_digest or a digest containing its own handle
digest_graph.canonical_encoding: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme encoded as UTF-8; duplicate keys, NaN, Infinity, non-canonical numbers, invalid Unicode and unknown fields fail

stage_1_intent_payload_digest.typed_request_rule: Core materializes every field allowed or required by the selected request profile, including operation/selector and sibling DTO fields; omitted/default/null distinctions are canonical and authority handle fields occupy a fixed null sentinel

trusted_intent_contract.dispatch_recomputation: Phase 4 Core reparses the complete typed request against the installed closed schema, recomputes intent_payload_digest, verifies authority binding and replay burn, recomputes trusted_envelope_digest, then compares every field and profile ID before enqueue or dispatch
trusted_intent_contract.dispatch_rule: Core dispatches only an envelope it constructed through core_direct_safe_v1 or after external_attestation_v1 verification; executed capability, command, argv tokens, target refs and next state exactly equal the validated envelope
trusted_intent_contract.excluded_scope: Phase 1A trusted GUI internal Application Service calls have no public Agent/CLI dispatch, remain behind the narrow ExecutionAuthorizationPolicy and do not construct trusted intent

core_direct_safe_v1.construction: Phase 4 Core independently parses the installed catalog command, complete typed request and canonical argv/targets/profiles; Skill proposal fields are untrusted candidates and cannot supply control fields
core_direct_safe_v1.eligibility: classification Agent 直调, EFFECT_LOCAL_READ, APPROVAL_NONE, JOB_NONE, and profile proves zero network, upload, disk write, charge and external mutation
core_direct_safe_v1.scope: direct-safe only; any effect, approval, job or eligibility ambiguity is unavailable

external_attestation_v1.freshness: issued_at/expires_at plus Core monotonic observation, maximum 120 seconds; rollback, replay, unknown issuer or missing event fails
external_attestation_v1.issuer_boundary: issuer and signer/verifier run outside Skill, Agent, Accessibility/automation bridges and data-plane parsers
external_attestation_v1.missing_attestation: every capability outside core_direct_safe_v1 remains unavailable unless verified_host_user_intent or the separate platform human-presence fallback is verified; no self-report, automated event, best-effort or LOCAL downgrade
external_attestation_v1.opaque_handle: non-forgeable single-verification handle bound to all primary claims and intent_payload_digest only; it never signs trusted_envelope_digest or its own handle digest
external_attestation_v1.unproven_user_source: request a separate HUMAN_PRESENCE_PROOF_V1 bound to the same intent_payload_digest; if platform proof is unavailable or fails, the capability remains unavailable
external_attestation_v1.verification: Phase 4 Core verifies pinned issuer identity and signature or MAC, authenticated principal/session, human actor class, allowed input source, audience, local uid, installation, origin event, nonce, intent_payload_digest, freshness and single use before construction
